title: [CQ-V03b] Recorded check dispatch and observation store
description:
Objective: record which check a trusted runner was asked to run (a recorded dispatch) and the one result it observed for it. Trust then follows the dispatch binding and the channel identity, never caller arguments.

This is the data slice of CQ-V03 (task-9cc13170), split out by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-29 (SPIDR Data). CQ-V03 wraps these functions as runner-channel tools, and CQ-V04 consumes isAuthenticatedCheckRun in delivery policy. It depends on V02 (DONE). It also depends on C08 (task-f12b03e8) and the bug task-bc8410af only because all three edit src/types/schema.ts, which the epic rail serializes.

Interface: a new module packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkObservationStore.ts.
- It follows the checkRunStore pattern: stateless functions taking the state first, with the caller holding state.mutex.
- `runner` is the channel identity, a plain `{ runnerId: string }` (CQ-V03a's RunnerIdentity shape). The caller passes it in; it is never read from params.
- Types go in src/types/schema.ts:
  - `export interface CheckDispatch { readonly id: string; readonly taskId: string; readonly candidateId: string; readonly treeSha: string; readonly planRevision: number; readonly command: string; readonly checkId?: string; readonly environment: string; readonly runnerId: string; readonly createdAt: string }`.
  - `export interface CheckObservation { readonly id: string; readonly checkRunId: string; readonly runnerId: string; readonly createdAt: string }`, whose id is the dispatchId.

`recordCheckDispatch(state, runner, params: { id?, taskId, candidateId, planRevision, command, checkId?, environment }): Promise<{ dispatch: CheckDispatch; duplicate: boolean }>`:
- The candidate must exist (CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND) and belong to taskId.
- It must be the task's CURRENT candidate: the last of listCandidatesForTask, the rule policy and get_context share. Otherwise CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_CURRENT; a superseded candidate never gets a new dispatch.
- planRevision must equal both task.planRevision and task.approvedPlanRevision. Otherwise CHECK_DISPATCH_REVISION_MISMATCH.
- treeSha comes from the candidate, and runnerId from `runner`.
- command uses checkRunStore's rule: verbatim, non-blank, at most 500 characters, because the result is written as a CheckRun.
- checkId uses the protected-check id rule.
- environment is 1-255 characters with no control characters.
- The id is caller-supplied (validateEntityId) or 'dispatch-<32 hex>'. An identical same-id replay returns duplicate:true; a differing one is CHECK_DISPATCH_IMMUTABLE.
- It is persisted at .moe/checks/dispatches/<id>.json. That subdirectory sits inside the already-gitignored checks/ dir, and loadEntities reads only top-level *.json files, so check runs never load it.

`recordCheckObservation(state, runner, params: { id, dispatchId, exitCode, outcome, outputTail?, environment }): Promise<{ checkRun: CheckRun; duplicate: boolean }>`:
- The dispatch must be recorded (CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_FOUND); only a recorded dispatch can be answered.
- runner.runnerId must equal dispatch.runnerId (CHECK_RUNNER_MISMATCH).
- environment must equal dispatch.environment exactly (CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH).
- outcome is required, under checkRunStore's coherence rule.
- params carry NO candidate, tree, command or revision. The CheckRun is built from three sources:
  - the dispatch: candidateId, treeSha, command, planRevision, environment and dispatchId;
  - `runner`: runnerId;
  - the observation: exitCode, outcome and outputTail, with source 'runner-observed'.
- It is written through the existing validateCheckRunParams and recordCheckRun. The tree match, the 16 KiB tail, same-id immutability (CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE) and identical-replay duplicates are reused unchanged.
- The CheckObservation marker is then written at .moe/checks/observations/<dispatchId>.json.
  - A marker that exists with a different checkRunId is CHECK_DISPATCH_ALREADY_OBSERVED: one result per dispatch.
  - An identical retry, including one after a crash between the two writes, completes the missing marker and returns duplicate.
- A dispatch whose candidate or revision has since been superseded can still be answered. That is recovery of a recorded dispatch, and the result stays bound to the dispatch's own candidate and revision, never the task's current ones.

`isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run: CheckRun): boolean` is true only when ALL of these hold:
- a marker exists for run.dispatchId, with checkRunId === run.id and runnerId === run.runnerId;
- its dispatch exists;
- the run's candidateId, treeSha, command, planRevision and environment equal the dispatch's;
- the run's source is 'runner-observed'.
It never throws and fails closed to false. A run recorded through moe.record_check_run, whatever its source, runnerId or dispatchId, is therefore never authenticated: it stays diagnostic.

src/state/StateManager.ts loads checkDispatches and checkObservations maps from those directories, so recovery works across a daemon restart.

Scope boundaries:
- No MCP tool (that is CQ-V03), no channel code (CQ-V03a), and no delivery-policy wiring (CQ-V04).
- record_check_run, checkRunStore and passedOn stay untouched, so legacy, local-branch and every other existing policy result is unchanged.
- No docs: CQ-V03 owns them. Never edit .moe directly.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: A run recorded through record_check_run with source 'runner-observed', any runnerId and a real recorded dispatchId fails isAuthenticatedCheckRun, while recordCheckObservation's run passes it (vitest).

A duplicate observation id with an identical payload returns duplicate:true and writes nothing. A conflicting payload is CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE, and a second observation id for the same dispatch is CHECK_DISPATCH_ALREADY_OBSERVED.

recordCheckObservation refuses an unrecorded dispatch (CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_FOUND), a different runner and a different environment. After the task gets a newer candidate, a recorded dispatch's observation still binds to the dispatch's candidate and revision, and recordCheckDispatch refuses the superseded candidate (CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_CURRENT).
Dispatches and markers reload from disk in a fresh StateManager, and an identical retry after a crash between the CheckRun write and the marker write completes the marker.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
Do not modify checkRunStore.ts, recordCheckRun.ts or delivery/policy.ts: legacy policy results must stay byte-identical.

implementationPlan.description:
Types and loading.

packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts: next to CheckRun, add the exported `CheckDispatch` and `CheckObservation` interfaces exactly as in the task description, with comments in CheckRun's style:
- CheckDispatch: a request pinned while current; immutable; runner-channel only.
- CheckObservation: id = dispatchId, at most one per dispatch, written only by checkObservationStore. A record_check_run run never has one.
The CheckRun type is NOT changed.

packages/moe-daemon/src/state/StateManager.ts:
- Add `checkDispatches = new Map<string, CheckDispatch>()` and `checkObservations = new Map<string, CheckObservation>()`, each with a one-line comment (written only via state/checkObservationStore.ts, which has no update or delete path).
- Beside the checkRuns load, add `loadEntities<CheckDispatch>(path.join(this.moePath, 'checks', 'dispatches'))` and the same for 'observations'. loadEntities tolerates a missing directory.
- No other change. Preserve peers' bytes: StateManager and schema.ts are shared, and C08 and bc8410af, both prerequisites, edit schema.ts.

Create packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkObservationStore.ts and implement recordCheckDispatch. The header comment follows checkRunStore's: RECORDING ONLY, immutable by construction (no update or delete function), and the caller holds state.mutex. Refusals are MoeErrors with codeNames, and each one writes nothing.

Reuse, never re-implement: getCandidate, listCandidatesForTask, caseVariantId, hasControlChar and renderGot (candidateStore.ts); validateEntityId (util/sanitize.ts); generateId('dispatch') (util/ids.ts); invalidInput, missingRequired and notFound (util/errors.ts).

Error handling, in this exact order:
1. runner must be an object whose runnerId passes validateEntityId; otherwise invalidInput('runner', ...).
2. Validate the params:
   - id is optional and passes validateEntityId;
   - taskId and candidateId are entity ids;
   - planRevision is a safe integer >= 1;
   - command is a string, non-blank, at most 500 characters and kept verbatim;
   - checkId is optional and matches /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/, the validateRequiredChecks rule in validators.ts;
   - environment is a non-blank string of at most 255 characters with no control character, kept verbatim.
3. If a dispatch with the same id is stored: an identical replay in every recorded field returns { dispatch: copy, duplicate: true }; otherwise throw STATE_CONFLICT CHECK_DISPATCH_IMMUTABLE with context differingFields. This BEFORE any currency check, so a crash retry after supersession still replays.
4. A case-variant id is CHECK_DISPATCH_ID_CASE_COLLISION.
5. The task must exist: notFound('Task', ...).
6. The candidate must exist (NOT_FOUND CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND) and have candidate.taskId === taskId (CHECK_DISPATCH_TASK_MISMATCH).
7. The last of listCandidatesForTask must be this candidate (CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_CURRENT).
8. planRevision === task.planRevision === task.approvedPlanRevision (CHECK_DISPATCH_REVISION_MISMATCH).
9. Build the record in the documented key order, with conditional spreading of checkId, treeSha from the candidate, runnerId from runner and createdAt from the daemon clock. Persist with `await state.writeEntity('checks/dispatches', id, record)` BEFORE `state.checkDispatches.set`, so a failed write leaves nothing.

Also export getCheckDispatch(state, id), which returns a copy or null.

In checkObservationStore.ts, implement recordCheckObservation and isAuthenticatedCheckRun. Report the file in modifiedFiles.

recordCheckObservation(state, runner, params). Error handling, in order; each refusal writes nothing:
1. runner is validated as in recordCheckDispatch. id and dispatchId must pass validateEntityId. outcome must be present (missingRequired('outcome')).
2. The dispatch must exist: NOT_FOUND CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_FOUND. Only a recorded dispatch can be answered.
3. runner.runnerId must equal dispatch.runnerId: NOT_ALLOWED CHECK_RUNNER_MISMATCH.
4. params.environment must equal dispatch.environment exactly: STATE_CONFLICT CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.
5. If a marker for dispatchId exists with checkRunId !== params.id, throw STATE_CONFLICT CHECK_DISPATCH_ALREADY_OBSERVED.
6. Build the CheckRun parameters ONLY from these sources:
   - the dispatch: candidateId, treeSha, command, planRevision, environment, and dispatchId (its id);
   - runner: runnerId;
   - params: id, exitCode, outcome and outputTail;
   - source: 'runner-observed'.
   Then call validateCheckRunParams and recordCheckRun from the UNCHANGED checkRunStore.ts. Its refusals propagate (CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE and the INVALID_INPUT coherence and tail rules), as does its duplicate result.
7. If no marker exists, write { id: dispatchId, checkRunId, runnerId, createdAt } with `state.writeEntity('checks/observations', dispatchId, marker)`, then map.set.
8. Return { checkRun, duplicate }, where duplicate is recordCheckRun's.
   A crash between steps 6 and 7 leaves a run without a marker. The identical retry gets duplicate:true from recordCheckRun and then writes the marker.

isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run):
- Wrap the whole body in try/catch and return false on any error.
- Look up the STORED run by run.id; a caller-built object never authenticates itself. If it is absent, false.
- Require all of these:
  - stored.source === 'runner-observed';
  - stored.dispatchId is a string;
  - the marker exists, with checkRunId === stored.id and runnerId === stored.runnerId;
  - the dispatch exists;
  - the dispatch's runnerId, candidateId, treeSha, command, planRevision and environment are each === the stored run's.
- Export getCheckObservation(state, dispatchId) too.

Make every test pass with `npx vitest run src/state/checkObservationStore.test.ts`.

VERIFY ONCE. Edit only what this step's findings need, and report it in modifiedFiles.

1. Mutants. Apply each to a scratch copy of checkObservationStore.ts, restore it, then `cmp` afterwards. Each must fail at least one test:
   1. Skip the marker check in isAuthenticatedCheckRun: O2 fails.
   2. Judge the passed object instead of the stored run: O2 fails on the caller-built object.
   3. Bind the observation to the task's current candidate instead of dispatch.candidateId: O5 fails.
   4. Skip the runner compare: O4 fails.
   5. Allow a second observation id: O3 fails.
   6. Check currency before the replay: D3 fails on the superseded replay.
   7. Write the marker before the CheckRun: R2 fails.
2. Confirm `git diff --stat` shows no change to checkRunStore.ts, recordCheckRun.ts or delivery/policy.ts (task rail).
3. The GATE runs fresh in an isolated Linux snapshot (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate).
   - Take `git archive HEAD` of the WHOLE repo.
   - Overlay ONLY this task's 4 files.
   - Run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` after checking that the lockfile matches the tree modulo CR.
   - Use `env -i` with HOME, NO_COLOR=1 and the nvm node bin on a Linux-only PATH.
   - Run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit`. Both must exit 0. schema.ts is a shared type, so the full suite is the right scope.
   - `cmp` the overlay against the worktree.
4. A red run outside this task is compared against a snapshot WITHOUT the overlay. Never edit peer files.
5. Supply the npm test command, its exit code and the output tail to complete_task.

comments.author: architect-e4b7eee0
comments.content:
Planning note from architect-e4b7eee0, who split this slice out of V03:
- Require planRevision >= 1 at dispatch time. checkRunStore's readPlanRevision refuses anything below 1, so a revision-0 dispatch could never be answered. Refuse it up front with CHECK_DISPATCH_REVISION_MISMATCH.
- The consumer plan (V03 rev 1, the tool slice) calls these functions with the exact names in this description: recordCheckDispatch(state, runner, params), recordCheckObservation(state, runner, params) and isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run). It asserts these codeNames: CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_CURRENT, CHECK_DISPATCH_REVISION_MISMATCH, CHECK_DISPATCH_IMMUTABLE, CHECK_DISPATCH_NOT_FOUND, CHECK_RUNNER_MISMATCH, CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH and CHECK_DISPATCH_ALREADY_OBSERVED.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
A new store, state/checkObservationStore.ts, records CheckDispatch requests and their CheckObservation markers.
- recordCheckDispatch pins the task's current candidate, its tree, the approved revision, the command, the environment and the channel runnerId while they are current.
- recordCheckObservation answers only a recorded dispatch, by the same runner and in the same environment. It writes a CheckRun whose binding comes from the dispatch, through the unchanged checkRunStore, then a one-per-dispatch marker.
- isAuthenticatedCheckRun is true only for a STORED run with a matching marker and dispatch. A record_check_run run is never authenticated.
- Both maps reload at startup, so a recorded dispatch survives a crash and remains recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: record_check_run runs with copied runnerIds, dispatchIds and bindings fail isAuthenticatedCheckRun, and runs recorded through recordCheckObservation pass it.
Duplicate observation ids replay identically or refuse conflicts (CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE), and a dispatch accepts one observation only (CHECK_DISPATCH_ALREADY_OBSERVED).
An unrecorded dispatch, a different runner or a different environment is refused. A superseded dispatch is answered against its own binding, and a new dispatch for a superseded candidate is refused.
Dispatches and markers reload from disk. An identical retry after a crash between the two writes completes the marker.
In a fresh Linux snapshot, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` both exit 0.
invariants: checkRunStore.ts, recordCheckRun.ts and delivery/policy.ts are byte-unchanged, so every existing policy result is identical.
An observation's candidate, tree, command, revision and environment come ONLY from its dispatch, and its runnerId ONLY from the runner argument.
Every refusal precedes the first write. The CheckRun is written before the marker. Persistence happens before the map set.
isAuthenticatedCheckRun never throws and judges only stored records.
No update or delete function exists for either record.
compatibility: The CheckRun shape and the existing .moe/checks/<id>.json files are unchanged, and checkRuns loading is unaffected by the new subdirectories.
CQ-V03 wraps these functions as tools, and CQ-V04 wires isAuthenticatedCheckRun into policy.
approvedScope: New state/checkObservationStore.ts: recordCheckDispatch, getCheckDispatch, recordCheckObservation, getCheckObservation and isAuthenticatedCheckRun, plus its test.
The checkDispatches and checkObservations maps and loads in StateManager.ts.
reuse: recordCheckRun and validateCheckRunParams from packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkRunStore.ts write the observed run unchanged.
getCandidate, listCandidatesForTask, caseVariantId, hasControlChar and renderGot from packages/moe-daemon/src/state/candidateStore.ts.
writeEntity and loadEntities from packages/moe-daemon/src/state/persistence.ts, via StateManager.
The checkId rule copies the validateRequiredChecks id regex in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts.
sourceAssumptions: packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkRunStore.ts: recordCheckRun(state, params) returns {checkRun, duplicate}. Its order is validate, candidate, tree, replay-or-CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE, case collision, attempt, persist. readPlanRevision requires >= 1.

packages/moe-daemon/src/state/candidateStore.ts: listCandidatesForTask(state, taskId), whose last element is the current candidate (the same rule as policy.ts hasPassingCheck), and getCandidate(state, id).
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/persistence.ts: loadEntities reads only *.json entries of the directory, and writeEntity joins moePath with kind.
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/FileWatcher.ts watches project.json, epics, tasks, workers, proposals, channels, pins and decisions, but not checks.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. A daemon-only trust field on CheckRun (observedVia). Rejected: it needs checkRunStore and RECORDED_FIELDS changes in a store the task rail freezes. A separate marker leaves CheckRun and every legacy policy result byte-identical.
2. A new top-level .moe/dispatches/ directory. Rejected: it needs gitignore and init churn (root .gitignore, generate-init-files.ts, initFiles.test.ts). The checks/ subdirectories inherit the existing ignore, and loadEntities only reads top-level *.json.
3. A per-record MAC with the runner key. Rejected: any host process able to write .moe can read the key under legacy, and under verified-local guests cannot write host files. It adds no boundary.
4. CHOSEN: an immutable dispatch pinned while current, a CheckRun written through the unchanged checkRunStore, and a one-per-dispatch marker. The trust predicate requires a marker, a dispatch and an exact binding match on the STORED run.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- checkRunStore.recordCheckRun(state, params) already handles validation, the tree match, replay or CHECK_RUN_IMMUTABLE, case collision and persist-before-publish. validateCheckRunParams and CHECK_OUTCOMES are exported. readPlanRevision refuses values below 1.
- candidateStore exports getCandidate, listCandidatesForTask (whose last element is the current candidate), caseVariantId, hasControlChar and renderGot.
- persistence.writeEntity(state, kind, id, entity) path.joins moePath and kind, so 'checks/dispatches' works on Windows, then guards traversal and writes atomically.
- loadEntities(dir) reads only top-level *.json files.
- FileWatcher never watches checks/.
- StateManager declares its entity maps around line 393 and loads them around line 1117.
- Task.planRevision and approvedPlanRevision are optional numbers (schema.ts around 834-850).
planningNotes.risks:
- Ordering matters. The replay must come before the currency check, or recovery breaks. The marker is written only after the CheckRun, or a crash leaves an orphan marker.
- Squatting: an attacker can pre-record an identical run under a guessed id. That is harmless, and the runner should use random ids anyway (V04).
- schema.ts is serialized behind C08 and bc8410af; WORKING waits for them.
- The test fixture needs a task carrying planRevision and approvedPlanRevision. Set them the way existing tests do, never through a .moe hand edit.
- Keep the module under about 250 lines.
